铜钟修灯师·伊弥.farewell: 灯能自己续亮，账却不会自己改成赢。铜阶城的账册不只一页。你先拿走掌声，欠账给我留下。
铜钟修灯师·伊弥.farewellEn: The lamp can mend its flame. The ledger will not mend itself into a win. The Citadel ledger has more than one page. Take the applause for now. Leave the debt with me.
铜钟修灯师·伊弥.echo: 你总想等我先熄灭，结果等完的是自己的灯芯。铜阶不会替急着下楼的人变矮。把最后一点体面收好，别也拿去献祭。
铜钟修灯师·伊弥.echoEn: You kept waiting for my light to fail. Your own wick finished first. Brass stairs do not shrink for someone rushing down them. Keep that last scrap of dignity. Do not sacrifice it too.

铜钟浮辉使·欧弥.farewell: 我输得倒很朴素，倒显得你的庆功有点铺张。悬钟还在响，我可没听见散场铃。记分可以，庆功请等我离开牌桌以后。
铜钟浮辉使·欧弥.farewellEn: My defeat was quite plain. Your celebration seems extravagant by comparison. The hanging bells still ring; none sounded a dismissal. Keep score if you like; celebrate after I leave the table.
铜钟浮辉使·欧弥.echo: 我只按落点出手，你却把简单的事想成了远路。悬钟数得清拍子，你却总抢错一拍。下次来时，把借口也编进牌组吧。
铜钟浮辉使·欧弥.echoEn: I struck where I stood. You turned a simple task into a long detour. The hanging bells count every beat. You kept hurrying the wrong one. Next time, put your excuses in the deck too.

炽砂铠卫领誓·乌弥.farewell: 这面盾该送去修灯铺，专修被运气擦伤的面子。炉门没关，坏结果也还能回炉。我会承认点数，至于你的运气，还得另审。
炽砂铠卫领誓·乌弥.farewellEn: This shield needs a lamplighter: my pride has a nasty scratch from luck. The kiln door is open. A bad result can still be recast. I accept the points. Your luck requires a separate hearing.
炽砂铠卫领誓·乌弥.echo: 你以为绕过盾就是捷径？我一直在等那一步。你把炉门当出口，难怪最后只剩一阵灰。我只检查落点，不替你保管侥幸。
炽砂铠卫领誓·乌弥.echoEn: You thought passing the shield was a shortcut? I was waiting for that step. You took the kiln door for an exit. No wonder only ash remained. I inspect landing places. I do not keep your luck safe.

炽砂铠卫领誓·依弥.farewell: 我把最后一点暖意留给了同伴，没留给这张难看的成绩。炉门没关，坏结果也还能回炉。这张桌子记性不错，我也一样。
炽砂铠卫领誓·依弥.farewellEn: I left my last warmth to my companions, not to this ugly result. The kiln door is open. A bad result can still be recast. This table has a good memory. So do I.
炽砂铠卫领誓·依弥.echo: 你把告别当作结账，却没看见灯盏又亮了一分。你把炉门当出口，难怪最后只剩一阵灰。散场不需要掌声，记住哪里站空了就好。
炽砂铠卫领誓·依弥.echoEn: You thought a farewell settled the bill. You missed the lamp brightening again. You took the kiln door for an exit. No wonder only ash remained. Dismissal needs no applause. Remember the place you left empty.

炽砂枝灯树灵领誓·雅弥.farewell: 我挡住那么多锋刃，竟没挡住你这点小算计。赤砂工坊会把这份难看熔成新模。赢一局很响，未必压得住灯下那点风。
炽砂枝灯树灵领誓·雅弥.farewellEn: I stopped so many blades, yet missed your little calculation. The red-sand workshops will melt this embarrassment into a new mold. A win sounds loud. It may not drown the draft beneath a lamp.
炽砂枝灯树灵领誓·雅弥.echo: 护住一格就够了；你却把整条退路都让了出来。赤砂还热着，你倒先把手缩回去了。这次是灯先熄，愿下次是你的迟疑先熄。
炽砂枝灯树灵领誓·雅弥.echoEn: One guarded lane was enough. You offered me the whole escape route. The red sand is still warm. Your hand withdrew first. Your lamp went out first this time. Next time, let hesitation go first.

炽砂灯议长·诺弥.farewell: 路还在左边，胜负却被你挪到了右边。赤砂工坊会把这份难看熔成新模。我会承认点数，至于你的运气，还得另审。

炽砂潜印客·欧安.farewell: 我把下一张算进去了，没想到你先把这一张算尽了。赤砂工坊会把这份难看熔成新模。把这局收好，回执还在路上。
炽砂潜印客·欧安.farewellEn: I counted the next card. You finished counting this one first. The red-sand workshops will melt this embarrassment into a new mold. Keep this match safe. Its receipt is still on the way.
炽砂潜印客·欧安.echo: 牌多不等于心急；我只是比你多留了一条回答。赤砂还热着，你倒先把手缩回去了。倒下前，至少记清欠的是哪一盏灯。
炽砂潜印客·欧安.echoEn: More cards do not mean haste. I simply kept one more answer than you did. The red sand is still warm. Your hand withdrew first. Before you fall, at least remember which lamp you owe.

炽砂观灯师·乌安.farewell: 我输得倒很朴素，倒显得你的庆功有点铺张。工坊不收废灯，我也不收这一声服气。这张桌子记性不错，我也一样。
炽砂观灯师·乌安.farewellEn: My defeat was quite plain. Your celebration seems extravagant by comparison. The workshops reject dead lamps. I reject that word of surrender. This table has a good memory. So do I.
炽砂观灯师·乌安.echo: 我只按落点出手，你却把简单的事想成了远路。火候差一点，整张契约就只能重铸。散场不需要掌声，记住哪里站空了就好。
炽砂观灯师·乌安.echoEn: I struck where I stood. You turned a simple task into a long detour. A little wrong with the heat, and the whole pact needs recasting. Dismissal needs no applause. Remember the place you left empty.

炽砂铠卫·依安.farewell: 我把反拍留得太久，竟让你先把乐谱合上了。炉门没关，坏结果也还能回炉。赢一局很响，未必压得住灯下那点风。

砂镜巡灯使·依尘.farewell: 我把下一张算进去了，没想到你先把这一张算尽了。等最后一道回声回来，再替我记分。我会承认点数，至于你的运气，还得另审。
砂镜巡灯使·依尘.farewellEn: I counted the next card. You finished counting this one first. Score me after the last echo returns. I accept the points. Your luck requires a separate hearing.
砂镜巡灯使·依尘.echo: 牌多不等于心急；我只是比你多留了一条回答。最后一道回声都追上来了，你还没决定往哪一格站。我只检查落点，不替你保管侥幸。
砂镜巡灯使·依尘.echoEn: More cards do not mean haste. I simply kept one more answer than you did. The last echo caught up while you were still choosing a lane. I inspect landing places. I do not keep your luck safe.

砂镜巡灯使·雅尘.farewell: 账页翻得再快，也没赶上你掀掉我的落点。回声矿井会把这一声不服多说几遍。我会承认点数，至于你的运气，还得另审。
砂镜巡灯使·雅尘.farewellEn: I turned the ledger quickly, but you cleared my landing first. The echoing shafts will repeat my objection several times. I accept the points. Your luck requires a separate hearing.
砂镜巡灯使·雅尘.echo: 你把牌库当背景，我把它当还没开口的同伴。矿井一直在回你的话，可惜没一句是捷径。我只检查落点，不替你保管侥幸。
砂镜巡灯使·雅尘.echoEn: You treated the deck as scenery. I treated it as an ally yet to speak. The shafts kept answering you. None of the answers was a shortcut. I inspect landing places. I do not keep your luck safe.

砂镜掠风鸟·诺尘.farewell: 我把下一张算进去了，没想到你先把这一张算尽了。砂镜还留着我站着的样子。你先拿走掌声，欠账给我留下。
砂镜掠风鸟·诺尘.farewellEn: I counted the next card. You finished counting this one first. The sandmirror still keeps an image of me standing. Take the applause for now. Leave the debt with me.
砂镜掠风鸟·诺尘.echo: 牌多不等于心急；我只是比你多留了一条回答。你只看镜里的退路，忘了脚下还有深浅。把最后一点体面收好，别也拿去献祭。
砂镜掠风鸟·诺尘.echoEn: More cards do not mean haste. I simply kept one more answer than you did. You watched the escape in the mirror and forgot the ground had depth. Keep that last scrap of dignity. Do not sacrifice it too.

砂镜潜印客·瑟尘.farewell: 路还在左边，胜负却被你挪到了右边。回声矿井会把这一声不服多说几遍。我会承认点数，至于你的运气，还得另审。
砂镜潜印客·瑟尘.farewellEn: The road was still on the left. You moved the result to the right. The echoing shafts will repeat my objection several times. I accept the points. Your luck requires a separate hearing.
砂镜潜印客·瑟尘.echo: 你守的是我刚才的位置，不是我最后停下的位置。矿井一直在回你的话，可惜没一句是捷径。我只检查落点，不替你保管侥幸。
砂镜潜印客·瑟尘.echoEn: You guarded where I was, not where I finally stood. The shafts kept answering you. None of the answers was a shortcut. I inspect landing places. I do not keep your luck safe.

砂镜潜印客·维尘.farewell: 换位本是礼数，没想到这回把胜利也让给你了。砂镜还留着我站着的样子。把这局收好，回执还在路上。
砂镜潜印客·维尘.farewellEn: A swap was meant as courtesy. This one handed you victory too. The sandmirror still keeps an image of me standing. Keep this match safe. Its receipt is still on the way.
砂镜潜印客·维尘.echo: 你认得我的落点，却没记住我旁边也能站人。你只看镜里的退路，忘了脚下还有深浅。倒下前，至少记清欠的是哪一盏灯。
砂镜潜印客·维尘.echoEn: You knew my place and forgot someone could stand beside me. You watched the escape in the mirror and forgot the ground had depth. Before you fall, at least remember which lamp you owe.

砂镜观灯师·希尘.farewell: 我把下一张算进去了，没想到你先把这一张算尽了。砂镜还留着我站着的样子。我只是把下一步暂时藏在了桌子底下。

暮潮星枝鹿领誓·莱尘.farewell: 灯能自己续亮，账却不会自己改成赢。潮水翻账的时候，希望你还坐得这么稳。这张桌子记性不错，我也一样。
暮潮星枝鹿领誓·莱尘.farewellEn: The lamp can mend its flame. The ledger will not mend itself into a win. When the tide turns the ledger, I hope you sit just as steadily. This table has a good memory. So do I.
暮潮星枝鹿领誓·莱尘.echo: 你总想等我先熄灭，结果等完的是自己的灯芯。潮水没催你，是你自己先把岸让了出来。散场不需要掌声，记住哪里站空了就好。
暮潮星枝鹿领誓·莱尘.echoEn: You kept waiting for my light to fail. Your own wick finished first. The tide did not hurry you. You yielded the shore yourself. Dismissal needs no applause. Remember the place you left empty.

暮潮灯议长·岑尘.farewell: 这次空拍算你的；下次别把我的沉默当迟钝。这张回执先压在我的缆绳下面。赢一局很响，未必压得住灯下那点风。
暮潮灯议长·岑尘.farewellEn: That missed beat is yours. Do not mistake silence for slowness next time. Tuck that receipt under my mooring rope for now. A win sounds loud. It may not drown the draft beneath a lamp.
暮潮灯议长·岑尘.echo: 你以为轻轻一刀就不必付账？反拍也是拍。灯港认得每一艘归船，却不替忘路的人掌舵。这次是灯先熄，愿下次是你的迟疑先熄。
暮潮灯议长·岑尘.echoEn: You thought a light cut needed no payment? A counterbeat still counts. The lamp-harbor knows every returning boat, but steers none for the lost. Your lamp went out first this time. Next time, let hesitation go first.

暮潮浮辉使领誓·塔尘.farewell: 我还没喝完灯盏里的暖意，你就把杯子收走了。暮潮会退，可不会替我撤回这份不服。灯芯还热着，先别替我写结局。
暮潮浮辉使领誓·塔尘.farewellEn: I had not finished the warmth in the lamp-cup when you cleared the table. The dusk tide will ebb. My objection will not. The wick is still warm. Do not write my ending yet.
暮潮浮辉使领誓·塔尘.echo: 每次你以为只是擦伤，我都替自己续了一口气。夜汐码头最先收走的，就是你忘记系好的绳。天还没亮，你倒先把灯用完了。
暮潮浮辉使领誓·塔尘.echoEn: Each time you called it a scratch, I bought myself another breath. The night-tide quay first takes the rope you forgot to secure. It is not dawn yet. You finished your lamp early.

暮潮裂角客领誓·莫尘.farewell: 毒墨还没干，你倒先在胜负栏盖了章。码头还留着我的泊位。这张桌子记性不错，我也一样。
暮潮裂角客领誓·莫尘.farewellEn: The venom-ink was still wet when you stamped the result. My berth at the quay is still reserved. This table has a good memory. So do I.
暮潮裂角客领誓·莫尘.echo: 你每轮都说还能撑，听起来像一张越签越长的欠条。你看着远帆，却把脚下的跳板松开了。散场不需要掌声，记住哪里站空了就好。

暮潮折面星客领誓·依汀.farewellEn: I had not finished the warmth in the lamp-cup when you cleared the table. The dusk tide will ebb. My objection will not. I accept the points. Your luck requires a separate hearing.
暮潮折面星客领誓·依汀.echo: 每次你以为只是擦伤，我都替自己续了一口气。夜汐码头最先收走的，就是你忘记系好的绳。我只检查落点，不替你保管侥幸。
暮潮折面星客领誓·依汀.echoEn: Each time you called it a scratch, I bought myself another breath. The night-tide quay first takes the rope you forgot to secure. I inspect landing places. I do not keep your luck safe.

暮潮踏铃驹领誓·雅汀.farewell: 我还没喝完灯盏里的暖意，你就把杯子收走了。暮潮会退，可不会替我撤回这份不服。记分可以，庆功请等我离开牌桌以后。
暮潮踏铃驹领誓·雅汀.farewellEn: I had not finished the warmth in the lamp-cup when you cleared the table. The dusk tide will ebb. My objection will not. Keep score if you like; celebrate after I leave the table.
暮潮踏铃驹领誓·雅汀.echo: 每次你以为只是擦伤，我都替自己续了一口气。夜汐码头最先收走的，就是你忘记系好的绳。下次来时，把借口也编进牌组吧。
暮潮踏铃驹领誓·雅汀.echoEn: Each time you called it a scratch, I bought myself another breath. The night-tide quay first takes the rope you forgot to secure. Next time, put your excuses in the deck too.

暮潮星枝鹿领誓·诺汀.farewell: 别急着摸战利品，我身上最后一根刺还在找位置。码头还留着我的泊位。这张桌子记性不错，我也一样。
暮潮星枝鹿领誓·诺汀.farewellEn: Do not reach for the spoils yet. My last barb is still choosing a place. My berth at the quay is still reserved. This table has a good memory. So do I.
暮潮星枝鹿领誓·诺汀.echo: 你的出手很干脆，忘了把回来的那一下算进去。你看着远帆，却把脚下的跳板松开了。散场不需要掌声，记住哪里站空了就好。
暮潮星枝鹿领誓·诺汀.echoEn: A decisive strike. You forgot to count the part that came back. You watched distant sails and loosened the gangplank under your feet. Dismissal needs no applause. Remember the place you left empty.

暮潮折面星客领誓·瑟汀.farewell: 账页翻得再快，也没赶上你掀掉我的落点。暮潮会退，可不会替我撤回这份不服。记分可以，庆功请等我离开牌桌以后。
暮潮折面星客领誓·瑟汀.farewellEn: I turned the ledger quickly, but you cleared my landing first. The dusk tide will ebb. My objection will not. Keep score if you like; celebrate after I leave the table.
暮潮折面星客领誓·瑟汀.echo: 你把牌库当背景，我把它当还没开口的同伴。夜汐码头最先收走的，就是你忘记系好的绳。下次来时，把借口也编进牌组吧。
暮潮折面星客领誓·瑟汀.echoEn: You treated the deck as scenery. I treated it as an ally yet to speak. The night-tide quay first takes the rope you forgot to secure. Next time, put your excuses in the deck too.

暮潮灯议长·维汀.farewell: 刀锋正要学会你的名字，牌局却先学会了结束。暮潮会退，可不会替我撤回这份不服。赢一局很响，未必压得住灯下那点风。
暮潮灯议长·维汀.farewellEn: The edge was learning your name when the match learned to end. The dusk tide will ebb. My objection will not. A win sounds loud. It may not drown the draft beneath a lamp.
暮潮灯议长·维汀.echo: 你每送来一张倒牌，都替我的刀多磨了一寸。夜汐码头最先收走的，就是你忘记系好的绳。这次是灯先熄，愿下次是你的迟疑先熄。
暮潮灯议长·维汀.echoEn: Each fallen card you sent sharpened my edge a little further. The night-tide quay first takes the rope you forgot to secure. Your lamp went out first this time. Next time, let hesitation go first.

暮潮灯议长·希汀.farewell: 这次空拍算你的；下次别把我的沉默当迟钝。潮水翻账的时候，希望你还坐得这么稳。把这局收好，回执还在路上。
暮潮灯议长·希汀.farewellEn: That missed beat is yours. Do not mistake silence for slowness next time. When the tide turns the ledger, I hope you sit just as steadily. Keep this match safe. Its receipt is still on the way.
暮潮灯议长·希汀.echo: 你以为轻轻一刀就不必付账？反拍也是拍。潮水没催你，是你自己先把岸让了出来。倒下前，至少记清欠的是哪一盏灯。
暮潮灯议长·希汀.echoEn: You thought a light cut needed no payment? A counterbeat still counts. The tide did not hurry you. You yielded the shore yourself. Before you fall, at least remember which lamp you owe.

暮潮灯议长·洛汀.farewell: 换位本是礼数，没想到这回把胜利也让给你了。这张回执先压在我的缆绳下面。把这局收好，回执还在路上。
暮潮灯议长·洛汀.farewellEn: A swap was meant as courtesy. This one handed you victory too. Tuck that receipt under my mooring rope for now. Keep this match safe. Its receipt is still on the way.
暮潮灯议长·洛汀.echo: 你认得我的落点，却没记住我旁边也能站人。灯港认得每一艘归船，却不替忘路的人掌舵。倒下前，至少记清欠的是哪一盏灯。
暮潮灯议长·洛汀.echoEn: You knew my place and forgot someone could stand beside me. The lamp-harbor knows every returning boat, but steers none for the lost. Before you fall, at least remember which lamp you owe.

暮潮灯议长·米汀.farewell: 我把反拍留得太久，竟让你先把乐谱合上了。潮水翻账的时候，希望你还坐得这么稳。你先拿走掌声，欠账给我留下。
暮潮灯议长·米汀.farewellEn: I held the counterbeat too long. You closed the score first. When the tide turns the ledger, I hope you sit just as steadily. Take the applause for now. Leave the debt with me.
暮潮灯议长·米汀.echo: 刀先到，后悔随后到；可惜回声不接受撤回。潮水没催你，是你自己先把岸让了出来。把最后一点体面收好，别也拿去献祭。
暮潮灯议长·米汀.echoEn: The blade arrived first, regret second. Echoes do not accept cancellations. The tide did not hurry you. You yielded the shore yourself. Keep that last scrap of dignity. Do not sacrifice it too.

暮潮灯议长·岚汀.farewell: 路还在左边，胜负却被你挪到了右边。这张回执先压在我的缆绳下面。赢一局很响，未必压得住灯下那点风。
暮潮灯议长·岚汀.farewellEn: The road was still on the left. You moved the result to the right. Tuck that receipt under my mooring rope for now. A win sounds loud. It may not drown the draft beneath a lamp.
暮潮灯议长·岚汀.echo: 你守的是我刚才的位置，不是我最后停下的位置。灯港认得每一艘归船，却不替忘路的人掌舵。这次是灯先熄，愿下次是你的迟疑先熄。
暮潮灯议长·岚汀.echoEn: You guarded where I was, not where I finally stood. The lamp-harbor knows every returning boat, but steers none for the lost. Your lamp went out first this time. Next time, let hesitation go first.

暮潮峰脊巨灵领誓·索汀.farewell: 我挡住那么多锋刃，竟没挡住你这点小算计。暮潮会退，可不会替我撤回这份不服。你先拿走掌声，欠账给我留下。
暮潮峰脊巨灵领誓·索汀.farewellEn: I stopped so many blades, yet missed your little calculation. The dusk tide will ebb. My objection will not. Take the applause for now. Leave the debt with me.
暮潮峰脊巨灵领誓·索汀.echo: 护住一格就够了；你却把整条退路都让了出来。夜汐码头最先收走的，就是你忘记系好的绳。把最后一点体面收好，别也拿去献祭。
暮潮峰脊巨灵领誓·索汀.echoEn: One guarded lane was enough. You offered me the whole escape route. The night-tide quay first takes the rope you forgot to secure. Keep that last scrap of dignity. Do not sacrifice it too.

暮潮裂角客领誓·莱汀.farewell: 我还没喝完灯盏里的暖意，你就把杯子收走了。码头还留着我的泊位。赢一局很响，未必压得住灯下那点风。
暮潮裂角客领誓·莱汀.farewellEn: I had not finished the warmth in the lamp-cup when you cleared the table. My berth at the quay is still reserved. A win sounds loud. It may not drown the draft beneath a lamp.
暮潮裂角客领誓·莱汀.echo: 每次你以为只是擦伤，我都替自己续了一口气。你看着远帆，却把脚下的跳板松开了。这次是灯先熄，愿下次是你的迟疑先熄。
暮潮裂角客领誓·莱汀.echoEn: Each time you called it a scratch, I bought myself another breath. You watched distant sails and loosened the gangplank under your feet. Your lamp went out first this time. Next time, let hesitation go first.

暮潮地缝蠕虫领誓·岑汀.farewell: 毒墨还没干，你倒先在胜负栏盖了章。暮潮会退，可不会替我撤回这份不服。你先拿走掌声，欠账给我留下。
暮潮地缝蠕虫领誓·岑汀.farewellEn: The venom-ink was still wet when you stamped the result. The dusk tide will ebb. My objection will not. Take the applause for now. Leave the debt with me.
暮潮地缝蠕虫领誓·岑汀.echo: 你每轮都说还能撑，听起来像一张越签越长的欠条。夜汐码头最先收走的，就是你忘记系好的绳。把最后一点体面收好，别也拿去献祭。
暮潮地缝蠕虫领誓·岑汀.echoEn: Every round you said you could last. It sounded like a growing note of debt. The night-tide quay first takes the rope you forgot to secure. Keep that last scrap of dignity. Do not sacrifice it too.

暮潮棱耳猎犬领誓·塔汀.farewell: 我挡住那么多锋刃，竟没挡住你这点小算计。暮潮会退，可不会替我撤回这份不服。把这局收好，回执还在路上。
暮潮棱耳猎犬领誓·塔汀.farewellEn: I stopped so many blades, yet missed your little calculation. The dusk tide will ebb. My objection will not. Keep this match safe. Its receipt is still on the way.
暮潮棱耳猎犬领誓·塔汀.echo: 护住一格就够了；你却把整条退路都让了出来。夜汐码头最先收走的，就是你忘记系好的绳。倒下前，至少记清欠的是哪一盏灯。
暮潮棱耳猎犬领誓·塔汀.echoEn: One guarded lane was enough. You offered me the whole escape route. The night-tide quay first takes the rope you forgot to secure. Before you fall, at least remember which lamp you owe.

暮潮缄骨客领誓·莫汀.farewell: 棱甲还带着刺，胜利却先扎到了我自己。这张回执先压在我的缆绳下面。赢一局很响，未必压得住灯下那点风。
暮潮缄骨客领誓·莫汀.farewellEn: The armor kept its barbs; victory still managed to prick me. Tuck that receipt under my mooring rope for now. A win sounds loud. It may not drown the draft beneath a lamp.
暮潮缄骨客领誓·莫汀.echo: 你把每一下反刺都当成零钱，最后连命也找不开了。灯港认得每一艘归船，却不替忘路的人掌舵。这次是灯先熄，愿下次是你的迟疑先熄。
暮潮缄骨客领誓·莫汀.echoEn: You treated every thorn as small change. Now even your life cannot cover the total. The lamp-harbor knows every returning boat, but steers none for the lost. Your lamp went out first this time. Next time, let hesitation go first.

暮潮灯议长·伦汀.farewell: 我把下一张算进去了，没想到你先把这一张算尽了。潮水翻账的时候，希望你还坐得这么稳。灯芯还热着，先别替我写结局。
暮潮灯议长·伦汀.farewellEn: I counted the next card. You finished counting this one first. When the tide turns the ledger, I hope you sit just as steadily. The wick is still warm. Do not write my ending yet.
暮潮灯议长·伦汀.echo: 牌多不等于心急；我只是比你多留了一条回答。潮水没催你，是你自己先把岸让了出来。天还没亮，你倒先把灯用完了。
暮潮灯议长·伦汀.echoEn: More cards do not mean haste. I simply kept one more answer than you did. The tide did not hurry you. You yielded the shore yourself. It is not dawn yet. You finished your lamp early.

暮潮裂角客领誓·佩汀.farewell: 这面盾该送去修灯铺，专修被运气擦伤的面子。这张回执先压在我的缆绳下面。记分可以，庆功请等我离开牌桌以后。
暮潮裂角客领誓·佩汀.farewellEn: This shield needs a lamplighter: my pride has a nasty scratch from luck. Tuck that receipt under my mooring rope for now. Keep score if you like; celebrate after I leave the table.
暮潮裂角客领誓·佩汀.echo: 你以为绕过盾就是捷径？我一直在等那一步。灯港认得每一艘归船，却不替忘路的人掌舵。下次来时，把借口也编进牌组吧。
暮潮裂角客领誓·佩汀.echoEn: You thought passing the shield was a shortcut? I was waiting for that step. The lamp-harbor knows every returning boat, but steers none for the lost. Next time, put your excuses in the deck too.

暮潮修灯师·泽汀.farewell: 我能修好裂开的灯，修不好你这局过分顺手的运气。码头还留着我的泊位。这张桌子记性不错，我也一样。

暮潮巡灯使·乌芙.echoEn: I added a little lamp-oil. You were short an entire match of patience. The tide did not hurry you. You yielded the shore yourself. It is not dawn yet. You finished your lamp early.

暮潮修灯师·依芙.farewell: 我能修好裂开的灯，修不好你这局过分顺手的运气。这张回执先压在我的缆绳下面。这张桌子记性不错，我也一样。
暮潮修灯师·依芙.farewellEn: I mend cracked lamps, not the outrageous luck you had this match. Tuck that receipt under my mooring rope for now. This table has a good memory. So do I.
暮潮修灯师·依芙.echo: 你只看见我补回的一点，却没看见自己漏掉的那步。灯港认得每一艘归船，却不替忘路的人掌舵。散场不需要掌声，记住哪里站空了就好。
暮潮修灯师·依芙.echoEn: You noticed the life I restored, but not the move you omitted. The lamp-harbor knows every returning boat, but steers none for the lost. Dismissal needs no applause. Remember the place you left empty.

暮潮修灯师·雅芙.farewell: 账页翻得再快，也没赶上你掀掉我的落点。这张回执先压在我的缆绳下面。把这局收好，回执还在路上。

星铸灯议长·图烙.farewellEn: I chose the lightest wind and hit the heaviest card. Do not engrave this bit of luck on the star chart yet. The wick is still warm. Do not write my ending yet.
星铸灯议长·图烙.echo: 抬头看灯的时候，最好也看看谁从你头顶经过。观测台只记下发生的事，不替你补上没走的那步。天还没亮，你倒先把灯用完了。
星铸灯议长·图烙.echoEn: When you look up at the lamps, check who is passing overhead. The observatory records what happened, not the step you omitted. It is not dawn yet. You finished your lamp early.

星铸铠卫领誓·芮烙.farewell: 盾面没裂，偏偏记分牌先替我认了输。星铸的账，通常要比一局长得多。把这局收好，回执还在路上。
星铸铠卫领誓·芮烙.farewellEn: The shield is intact. Somehow the scorecard surrendered for me. A Starforged account usually runs longer than one match. Keep this match safe. Its receipt is still on the way.
星铸铠卫领誓·芮烙.echo: 你一直盯着我的盾，却没看见自己空着的那一格。你把愿望写得像坐标，可惜落点不认愿望。倒下前，至少记清欠的是哪一盏灯。
星铸铠卫领誓·芮烙.echoEn: You watched my shield and missed the empty lane on your own side. You wrote wishes like coordinates. Landing places do not honor wishes. Before you fall, at least remember which lamp you owe.

星铸环藤蛇领誓·阿玟.farewell: 灯能自己续亮，账却不会自己改成赢。别急着把这点运气刻进星盘。赢一局很响，未必压得住灯下那点风。
星铸环藤蛇领誓·阿玟.farewellEn: The lamp can mend its flame. The ledger will not mend itself into a win. Do not engrave this bit of luck on the star chart yet. A win sounds loud. It may not drown the draft beneath a lamp.
星铸环藤蛇领誓·阿玟.echo: 你总想等我先熄灭，结果等完的是自己的灯芯。观测台只记下发生的事，不替你补上没走的那步。这次是灯先熄，愿下次是你的迟疑先熄。
星铸环藤蛇领誓·阿玟.echoEn: You kept waiting for my light to fail. Your own wick finished first. The observatory records what happened, not the step you omitted. Your lamp went out first this time. Next time, let hesitation go first.

星铸裂角客领誓·艾玟.farewellEn: I had not finished the warmth in the lamp-cup when you cleared the table. In the next calculation, I shall count you as an error too. I only hid the next move under the table for a moment.

星铸潜印客领誓·图玟.farewell: 路还在左边，胜负却被你挪到了右边。星铸的账，通常要比一局长得多。你先拿走掌声，欠账给我留下。
星铸潜印客领誓·图玟.farewellEn: The road was still on the left. You moved the result to the right. A Starforged account usually runs longer than one match. Take the applause for now. Leave the debt with me.
星铸潜印客领誓·图玟.echo: 你守的是我刚才的位置，不是我最后停下的位置。你把愿望写得像坐标，可惜落点不认愿望。把最后一点体面收好，别也拿去献祭。
星铸潜印客领誓·图玟.echoEn: You guarded where I was, not where I finally stood. You wrote wishes like coordinates. Landing places do not honor wishes. Keep that last scrap of dignity. Do not sacrifice it too.

星铸铠卫领誓·芮玟.farewell: 路还在左边，胜负却被你挪到了右边。别急着把这点运气刻进星盘。记分可以，庆功请等我离开牌桌以后。
星铸铠卫领誓·芮玟.farewellEn: The road was still on the left. You moved the result to the right. Do not engrave this bit of luck on the star chart yet. Keep score if you like; celebrate after I leave the table.
星铸铠卫领誓·芮玟.echo: 你守的是我刚才的位置，不是我最后停下的位置。观测台只记下发生的事，不替你补上没走的那步。下次来时，把借口也编进牌组吧。
星铸铠卫领誓·芮玟.echoEn: You guarded where I was, not where I finally stood. The observatory records what happened, not the step you omitted. Next time, put your excuses in the deck too.

星铸铠卫领誓·阿斐.farewell: 这面盾该送去修灯铺，专修被运气擦伤的面子。下一次测算，我会把你也算作偏差。把这局收好，回执还在路上。
星铸铠卫领誓·阿斐.farewellEn: This shield needs a lamplighter: my pride has a nasty scratch from luck. In the next calculation, I shall count you as an error too. Keep this match safe. Its receipt is still on the way.
星铸铠卫领誓·阿斐.echo: 你以为绕过盾就是捷径？我一直在等那一步。星光照得够远，是你把近处看得太轻。倒下前，至少记清欠的是哪一盏灯。
星铸铠卫领誓·阿斐.echoEn: You thought passing the shield was a shortcut? I was waiting for that step. Starlight reached far enough. You took the nearby things too lightly. Before you fall, at least remember which lamp you owe.

星铸铠卫领誓·艾斐.farewell: 盾面没裂，偏偏记分牌先替我认了输。别急着把这点运气刻进星盘。我只是把下一步暂时藏在了桌子底下。
星铸铠卫领誓·艾斐.farewellEn: The shield is intact. Somehow the scorecard surrendered for me. Do not engrave this bit of luck on the star chart yet. I only hid the next move under the table for a moment.
星铸铠卫领誓·艾斐.echo: 你一直盯着我的盾，却没看见自己空着的那一格。观测台只记下发生的事，不替你补上没走的那步。纸上少一条退路，脚下就少一座桥。
星铸铠卫领誓·艾斐.echoEn: You watched my shield and missed the empty lane on your own side. The observatory records what happened, not the step you omitted. One less escape on paper is one less bridge underfoot.

星铸掠风鸟领誓·伊斐.farewell: 路还在左边，胜负却被你挪到了右边。浮光观测台还没给这局定名。记分可以，庆功请等我离开牌桌以后。

折光巡灯使·欧翎.farewell: 我把反拍留得太久，竟让你先把乐谱合上了。等棱镜转回来，希望你还认这张成绩。赢一局很响，未必压得住灯下那点风。
折光巡灯使·欧翎.farewellEn: I held the counterbeat too long. You closed the score first. When the prism turns back, I hope you still recognize that score. A win sounds loud. It may not drown the draft beneath a lamp.
折光巡灯使·欧翎.echo: 刀先到，后悔随后到；可惜回声不接受撤回。光线绕了远路，你的结局却一点也没绕开。这次是灯先熄，愿下次是你的迟疑先熄。
折光巡灯使·欧翎.echoEn: The blade arrived first, regret second. Echoes do not accept cancellations. The light took a detour. Your ending did not. Your lamp went out first this time. Next time, let hesitation go first.

砂镜铠卫领誓·诺翎.farewell: 我还没喝完灯盏里的暖意，你就把杯子收走了。等最后一道回声回来，再替我记分。你先拿走掌声，欠账给我留下。
砂镜铠卫领誓·诺翎.farewellEn: I had not finished the warmth in the lamp-cup when you cleared the table. Score me after the last echo returns. Take the applause for now. Leave the debt with me.
砂镜铠卫领誓·诺翎.echo: 每次你以为只是擦伤，我都替自己续了一口气。最后一道回声都追上来了，你还没决定往哪一格站。把最后一点体面收好，别也拿去献祭。
砂镜铠卫领誓·诺翎.echoEn: Each time you called it a scratch, I bought myself another breath. The last echo caught up while you were still choosing a lane. Keep that last scrap of dignity. Do not sacrifice it too.

铜钟铠卫领誓·瑟翎.farewell: 盾面没裂，偏偏记分牌先替我认了输。铜阶城的账册不只一页。我会承认点数，至于你的运气，还得另审。
铜钟铠卫领誓·瑟翎.farewellEn: The shield is intact. Somehow the scorecard surrendered for me. The Citadel ledger has more than one page. I accept the points. Your luck requires a separate hearing.
铜钟铠卫领誓·瑟翎.echo: 你一直盯着我的盾，却没看见自己空着的那一格。铜阶不会替急着下楼的人变矮。我只检查落点，不替你保管侥幸。
铜钟铠卫领誓·瑟翎.echoEn: You watched my shield and missed the empty lane on your own side. Brass stairs do not shrink for someone rushing down them. I inspect landing places. I do not keep your luck safe.

苔庭缄骨客·维翎.farewell: 账页翻得再快，也没赶上你掀掉我的落点。渡口的苔灯还没熄，别急着说天亮。把这局收好，回执还在路上。
苔庭缄骨客·维翎.farewellEn: I turned the ledger quickly, but you cleared my landing first. The causeway lamps still burn; do not announce dawn yet. Keep this match safe. Its receipt is still on the way.
苔庭缄骨客·维翎.echo: 你把牌库当背景，我把它当还没开口的同伴。你听见的是雾，不是替你求情的声音。倒下前，至少记清欠的是哪一盏灯。
苔庭缄骨客·维翎.echoEn: You treated the deck as scenery. I treated it as an ally yet to speak. That was mist you heard, not a voice pleading for you. Before you fall, at least remember which lamp you owe.

霜枝铜缄裂角客.farewell: 铜封契纹不是为了挡住纸片……下一次，我会把你的落点也封上。
霜枝铜缄裂角客.farewellEn: That brass seal was never meant for paper. Next time, I will seal your landing lane as well.
霜枝铜缄裂角客.echo: 你数清了我的角，却忘了替自己的余芯留一个位置。
霜枝铜缄裂角客.echoEn: You counted my horns but forgot to leave a lane for your own Wick.

霜枝苔痕赤角兽.farewell: 我的角撞碎过霜桥，却给你这张薄契绊倒。先收好笑声，桥那边还有风。
霜枝苔痕赤角兽.farewellEn: My horns shattered frost bridges, yet a paper pact tripped me. Save your laughter; there is still wind beyond the bridge.
霜枝苔痕赤角兽.echo: 冲锋也要看路。你的牌挤满了桥，却没有一张肯守住退路。
霜枝苔痕赤角兽.echoEn: Even a charge needs a clear road. Your cards crowded the bridge, but none guarded the way back.
